2608.05896.title: GSBF: Gaussian Splatting for Environment-Aware Beamforming
2608.05896.paper_summary: Beamforming plays a key role in multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. However, conventional beamforming design normally requires accurate instantaneous channel state information (CSI) and iterative optimization, which incur substantial pilot overhead and computational complexity. Recognizing that radio propagation is intrinsically governed by the physical geometry, we develop a 3D Gaussian splatting for environment-aware beamforming (GSBF) pipeline based on multi-modal data, which characterizes the environment through a persistent 3D Gaussian representation. Specifically, GSBF models the environmental scattering response with reciprocity-preserving bidirectional spherical Gaussian (Bi-SG) kernels and performs two-sided electromagnetic rasterization to render an angular propagator map. The rendered map is then aggregated through an over-complete array-manifold dictionary and projected to the constant-modulus beamformers, thereby synthesizing beams directly from the access point (AP) pose and user position without online instantaneous CSI. Simulations demonstrate that GSBF consistently outperforms baselines such as exhaustive beam alignment (EBA) with lower latency.
2608.05896.paper_summary_zh: 波束成形在多輸入多輸出（MIMO）通信系統中扮演著關鍵角色。<lb/>然而，傳統的波束成形設計通常需要準確的瞬時通道狀態信息（CSI）和迭代優化，這會產生大量的導頻開銷和計算複雜性。<lb/>意識到無線傳播本質上受物理幾何的支配，我們基於多模態數據開發了一個環境感知波束成形（GSBF）管道，該管道通過持久的3D高斯表示來表徵環境。<lb/>具體而言，GSBF使用保持互易性的雙向球面高斯（Bi-SG）核來建模環境散射響應，並執行雙面電磁光柵化以渲染角度傳播器圖。<lb/>然後，渲染的圖通過一個過完備的陣列流形字典進行聚合，並投影到恆模波束成形器上，從而直接從接入點（AP）位置和用戶位置合成波束，而無需在線瞬時CSI。<lb/>模擬結果表明，GSBF在延遲更低的情況下，始終優於基準方法，如徹底波束對齊（EBA）。
